Why California Businesses Choose American Discount Security (A.D.S.)

California Security Guard Services You Can Trust

Trusted Security Guard Company in California Since 1997

At American Discount Security (A.D.S.), we ensure your business receives the most professional security guard services in California. We provide customizable security solutions tailored to your needs, whether you require armed or unarmed security guards, event security, or commercial and residential protection.

Our licensed California security guards are trained to protect your property, employees, and assets with professionalism and vigilance. As your business grows, our security services evolve with you to ensure maximum protection and peace of mind.

We are committed to delivering the best security guards in California, providing 24/7 on-site security, patrol services, and emergency response solutions.

OUR SECURITY GUARD SERVICES

At American Discount Security (A.D.S.), we provide fast, reliable, and professional security guard services in California tailored to meet the specific needs of every client. With over 28 years of experience, our licensed and trained security guards deliver dependable protection for businesses, residences, and events of all sizes.
From armed and unarmed security guards to mobile patrol services, our goal is to ensure safety, prevent risks, and maintain peace of mind 24/7. Whether you need construction site security, event security, or commercial property protection, American Discount Security (A.D.S.) designs flexible solutions that fit your environment.

Unarmed Security Guards

03

24/7 On-Site Security

Our well-trained security professionals monitor your property 24 hours a day to ensure continuous safety and quick response to any potential threats.

05

Proactive Risk Prevention

American Discount Security (A.D.S.) can deploy trained security professionals to detect and prevent risks before they become serious issues, ensuring complete safety for your site.

Our armed security guards are skilled, licensed, and experienced in managing complex environments, offering advanced protection for your people and property.

04

Mobile Patrol Security Services

Our mobile patrol units perform strategic and random patrols throughout the day and night, ensuring full property coverage and effective risk prevention.

06

Customized Commercial Security

We tailor commercial and residential security services for corporations, apartment buildings, office complexes, hospitals, colleges, and hotels across California.

Event Security

American Discount Security (A.D.S.) can deploy trained security professionals to prevent any security risks before it becomes a problem.

06

Commercial Security

We customized our commercial property security services for corporations, apartment buildings, hospitals, colleges, office buildings and hotels.

WHY CHOOSE US?

At American Discount Security (A.D.S.), we proudly serve businesses and individuals across California with reliable and professional security guard services. Our security guard company is dedicated to protecting businesses, properties, and events across California, Texas, Oregon, and Washington. Whether you need armed or unarmed guards, event security, or on-site protection, we guarantee 100% client satisfaction and trusted protection by licensed professionals.

Flexible Pricing

We build lasting relationships with our California clients through flexible and affordable security service pricing. No long-term contracts are required, just quality protection when you need it. Fill out our form today to get the best security guard service in California at the lowest cost.

Licensed, Trained Security Officers

American Discount Security (A.D.S.) is a locally owned and operated California security guard company with more than 28 years of industry experience. Our professional security officers are fully trained, background-checked, and hold guard cards issued by the California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS). We provide dependable, well-trained guards who protect your property and peace of mind.

We provide guard monitoring and have radios and vehicles with GPS capability. Our Security Guards submit electronic daily reports and clients can access the reports real-time on our online GuardOne portal or receive daily PDF reports via email.
